title: French Defense: Advance Variation
line: White takes space with a pawn chain; Black piles up on its base and steps around a well-known trap.

steps.text: In the French Advance, White's pawn pushes past and the pawns lock into chains.
Black hits the base of White's chain with a pawn and a knight, and White guards it.
Bring the queen to b6. She is a third attacker on d4, and she eyes the pawn on b2.

also.c8d7: That is also played. This lesson brings the queen out first.

steps.text: A trap: if your knight takes now, the trades end with a bishop check from b5 that uncovers White's queen, and Black loses the queen.
So bring the bishop out to d7 first. It guards b5.

wrong.c6d4: That is the trap: after the trades on d4, the bishop checks from b5 and uncovers White's queen on yours.

steps.text: Now your bishop guards b5. Take the pawn on d4.

steps.after: Black has an extra pawn. White has a lead in development for it.

summary: In the Advance, Black piles up on the base of White's chain, and brings a bishop out before taking on it.
